title: Customer support: bespoke quantization-profile exception and calibration run for legacy LLM
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Customer SUP-5129 (large-regulated-plat) has requested a one-off quantization profile exception for a legacy LLM they ship to partners. They report significant accuracy regressions when using the platform's default INT8 profile; FP8 was not tested in their environment. Goal: run a bespoke calibration and accuracy-validation workflow for both INT8 and FP8 variants, produce calibration artifacts, and generate a signed-off exception config that can be deployed to the customer's Dedicated account with TTL and audit trail.

Background: The customer's model uses unusual layer norms and an early scaled-embedding block that we suspect causes outlier activation distributions. Our default per-tensor symmetric INT8 mapping and global clipping left a measurable quality delta on the customer's held-out eval set (delta BLEU ~3.2, token-level accuracy degradation ~2.8%). They need a safe, auditable exception while we iterate on a longer-term runtime fix.

Deliverables: bespoke calibration artifacts (per-layer scales, per-channel maps where needed), calibration script runbook, validation report with metric deltas and per-prompt failure cases, rollout plan (canary -> full) and rollback criteria, PR with exception config and audit metadata.

Scope: limited to model v2024-11-03 (customer pinned). This run will not change default profiles for other customers. Exception will be surfaced as a named profile under the customer's Dedicated config with an expiry of 90 days unless extended by agreement.
comments: 2025-02-14 09:12 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after initial triage call with Support and the customer. Customer provided eval set (SUP-5129-eval-v1, ~1.2k prompts) and a small representative throughput trace. Initial reproductions on hosted infra show token-level accuracy drop ~2.8% with default INT8 profile. FP16 baseline measured for reference.

2025-02-15 11:04 - Markus Chen: Reproduced accuracy regression locally on a 80B variant under quant-runner-03. Observed heavy outliers in embedding layer and first attention block. Plan: run three calibration strategies in parallel: 1) per-channel symmetric INT8, 2) asymmetric per-tensor INT8 with histogram clipping (KL), 3) pilot FP8 (if runtime supports) using narrow dynamic range. Will run with a 5k-sample synthetic calibration set derived from customer eval traffic. Estimated run time: 6-8 hours per strategy on dedicated GPU node.

2025-02-16 15:47 - Support (Lena Ortiz): Customer confirmed they can accept a time-limited exception (90 days). They want detailed validation and an explicit rollback path. Also requested that we store calibration artifacts in their S3 bucket with signed URLs and include checksums.

2025-02-17 08:30 - Markus Chen: Calibration jobs started. Job IDs: calib-20250217-int8-pc, calib-20250217-int8-kl, calib-20250217-fp8-pilot. Using calibration harness v0.9.2 and eval harness v1.4. Collected per-layer activation histograms and KL divergence stats. Early results: per-channel INT8 reduced BLEU delta to 0.9, asymmetric INT8 (KL) reduced to 1.1, FP8 pilot reduced to 0.6 but increased variance on long-context prompts. Need more runs with context-aware clipping for FP8.

2025-02-18 19:03 - DataOps (Samir Gupta): Uploaded calibration artifacts to s3://rwd-customer-artifacts/sup-5129/2025-02-18/. Manifests: calib-int8-pc.json (sha256: e3b0...), calib-int8-kl.json (sha256: 9f5a...), calib-fp8-pilot.json (sha256: a7c2...). Links added to ticket attachments.

Note: artifacts include per-layer scale vectors, per-channel maps for embedding blocks, and a small shim patch for runtime to load per-layer exceptions.

2025-02-19 10:20 - QA (Rina Valdez): Validation report drafted. Metrics: BLEU baseline (FP16) 28.4, INT8 default 25.2 (delta -3.2), INT8 per-channel 27.5 (delta -0.9), INT8-KL 27.3 (delta -1.1), FP8 pilot 27.8 (delta -0.6). Long-context perplexity: FP8 pilot shows +4% variance on >2k token prompts. Provided 23 failing prompts and suggested guardrails for FP8: context-length threshold and fallback-to-INT8/FP16 for suspect patterns. Report uploaded: confluence.redwood.ai/display/CAL/SUP-5129-calib-report-20250219

2025-02-20 14:02 - Markus Chen: Recommendation: ship named exception profile using INT8 per-channel artifacts as "sup-5129-int8-pc-v1" with TTL 90 days. FP8 remains experimental; propose a canary with 5% traffic and additional monitoring if customer requests. Created PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4142 (load-exception-config + validation hooks). Need design review for console exposure and billing/metrics treatment (PM input required).

2025-02-20 16:45 - PM (Olivia Ramos): Flagged for PM review on console experience and SLAs. Also requested explicit wording for the customer agreement that this is a temporary exception, and that platform team will revisit default profiles after root-cause fix. Added dependency PM-412 for legal/terms update.
resolution_plan: 1) Approve and merge PR 4142 to add exception-loading and safety checks. 2) Deploy to staging and run end-to-end smoke tests with customer eval set. 3) Create named profile 'sup-5129-int8-pc-v1' and attach TTL=90d, checksum, and audit metadata. 4) Run canary on Dedicated account (0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> full) with automated quality gates (BLEU threshold delta <=1.5 and no increase in latency >10%). 5) If canary fails, rollback to FP16 baseline for customer traffic and open ENG-xxxx for deeper runtime fix. 6) Deliver final validation report and hand off to Account Exec for contract amendment.
next_steps: Merge PR 4142 after code review and unit tests
Schedule staging deploy and run smoke validation (owner: Markus)
Confirm artifact upload to customer's S3 and provide signed URLs (owner: Samir)
PM to draft temporary-exception terms and update billing/console exposure (owner: Olivia)
Coordinate with Support for customer communication and scheduled canary window (owner: Lena)
